title: Lohri greeting 2027
hook: Happy Lohri from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Happy Lohri from all of us at Galvor.

May the bonfire be warm, the rewri and gajak plentiful, and the dhol loud enough to bring the neighbours out.

Here is to a good harvest and a sweet start to the year for you and your family.
alt_text: Festival card in Galvor violet and gold with a sparkle motif. It reads Happy Lohri, then: warm bonfires, sweet rewri and a good harvest. Below: from all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: Warm bonfires, sweet rewri and *a good harvest*.
slides.sub: From all of us at Galvor.

notes:
Greeting only, no marketing lesson. No numbers used. Check the date before scheduling: Lohri is usually observed on 13 January, and this slot is on the 14th.
